description: Checks if an action would be approved by your policy without running it. Returns approved/denied, remaining spend cap, and whether human approval is required.

action_type.description: The action category to check against policy, e.g. 'payment', 'email', 'on_chain'.

parameters.description: Action parameters to evaluate, including amount and recipient if applicable.

name: yax_check_policy

cap_remaining_usd.description: Remaining spend cap in USD for this agent in the current period.

decision.description: Policy decision: approved, denied, or requires_approval.

policy_version.description: Version of the policy that was evaluated, e.g. policy_v12.

requires_approval.description: Whether this action would require human approval before executing.

shade_guard.description: ShadeGuard check result: pass or fail.
